blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Parts of the Visayas and Mindanao may experience scattered rain showers and thunderstorms on Tuesday as the trough or extension of a low-pressure area (LPA) continues to affect the eastern section of the country, the state weather bureau said Monday.
